behavior.objective: Bring ee_site within 0.05 m of the target at any control tick within 200 ticks, using the reach criterion from examples/demo_reach.py.

interfaces.actions: Two normalized joint-position targets in [-1, 1], mapped to shoulder and elbow actuator ctrlrange; 0.02 s control period, 0.002 s physics period.
interfaces.observations: Trusted scripted controller reads MuJoCo model/data and target XYZ in the world frame. This is not a deployable sensor interface.

reset.training: No training in this example. Existing demo_reach.py samples joint positions uniformly in [-0.4, 0.4] rad with zero velocity and randomized reachable targets.
reset.native: Python random.Random(seed) samples each joint uniformly in [-0.4, 0.4] rad; velocity is zero. Targets are fixed per scenario. RNG samples differ from the MJX task.

assumptions: Uses examples/models/simple_arm.xml: 0.20 m and 0.18 m links, position actuators, gravity, and a non-colliding target marker.
World-frame Euclidean target error is measured from MuJoCo ee_site after stepping real actuator commands.
Matches the existing demo's any-arrival success criterion; does not require a sustained hold or evaluate contact safety.
Two fixed targets and six initial states demonstrate evaluation plumbing, not generalization or real-robot readiness.

outcomes.success: Minimum post-step ee_site target error is strictly below 0.05 m within 200 control ticks and no MuJoCo warnings occurred.
outcomes.failure: No target arrival within the horizon, any MuJoCo warning, invalid controller action, non-finite simulator state, or evaluator error. Contacts and sustained stability are not assessed.
